title: Photos | R&SVP – Hio Ridge, Bridgton, Maine
description: See R&SVP in Bridgton, Maine, from the getting ready rooms to the barn and ceremony field. Photos of our spaces and gatherings at the farm.
heading: Your wedding, *room by room.*
lede: These are our barn and grounds, from the getting ready rooms to the patio after dark. You'll also see our open house and community gatherings. We host weddings and events from May through October.

closing.body: The photos give you a first look. A tour lets you see the spaces together and discuss a layout for your guests. Contact Susan to arrange a visit.
